result:
Done. The sync script will now run automatically 15 seconds after every system startup:

**What was set up:**
- **`scripts/run-sync.bat`** — batch wrapper that waits 15 seconds then runs `sync.sh` (for network/services to be ready)
- **`scripts/install-autostart.ps1`** — installer that creates a Windows startup shortcut
- **Shortcut installed** to `%APPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup\SyncUpstream.lnk`

The shortcut runs minimized in the background. After future reboots, the sync will resume automatically instead of waiting for manual intervention. Check `data/sync-runs.log` to verify syncs are running on schedule.
